title: Carrier-free micellar CpG interacting with cell membrane for enhanced immunological treatment of HIV-1.
authors: Kim, Haejoo; Zhang, Wei; Hwang, Juyoung; An, Eun-Koung; Choi, Yeol Kyo; Moon, Eunyoung; Loznik, Mark; Huh, Yang Hoon; Herrmann, Andreas; Kwak, Minseok; Jin, Jun-O
one_liner_zh: 该文研究脂修饰CpG寡核苷酸自组装胶束与细胞膜互作以增强抗HIV免疫，虽含分子动力学模拟，但核心是免疫刺激与病毒治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Unmethylated CpG motifs activate toll-like receptor 9 (TLR9), leading to sequence- and species-specific immune stimulation. Here, we engineered a CpG oligodeoxyribonucleotide (ODN) with multiple hydrophobic moieties, so-called lipid-modified uracil, which resulted in a facile micelle formation of the stimulant. The self-assembled CpG nanostructure (U4CpG) containing the ODN 2216 sequence was characterized by various spectroscopic and microscopic methods together with molecular dynamics simulations. Next, we evaluated the nano-immunostimulant for enhancement of anti-HIV immunity. U4CpG treatment induced activation of plasmacytoid dendritic cells (pDCs) and natural killer (NK) cells in healthy human peripheral blood, which produced type I interferons (IFNs) and IFN-gamma in human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs). Moreover, we validated the activation and promotion efficacy of U4CpG in patient-derived blood cells, and HIV-1 spread was significantly suppressed by a low dosage of the immunostimulant. Furthermore, U4CpG-treated PBMC cultured medium elicited transcription of latent HIV-1 in U1 cells indicating that U4CpG reversed HIV-1 latency. Thus, the functions of U4CpG in eradicating HIV-1 by enhancing immunity and reversing latency make the material a potential candidate for clinical studies dealing with viral infection.
abstract_zh: 未甲基化CpG基序激活toll样受体9（TLR9），导致序列和物种特异性的免疫刺激。在此，我们设计了一种含有多个疏水部分（即脂质修饰尿嘧啶）的CpG寡脱氧核苷酸（ODN），这促进了刺激物的简便胶束形成。含有ODN 2216序列的自组装CpG纳米结构（U4CpG）通过多种光谱和显微镜方法以及分子动力学模拟进行了表征。接下来，我们评估了该纳米免疫刺激剂在增强抗HIV免疫方面的效果。U4CpG处理诱导了健康人外周血中浆细胞样树突状细胞（pDCs）和自然杀伤（NK）细胞的激活，这些细胞在人外周血单核细胞（PBMCs）中产生了I型干扰素（IFNs）和干扰素-γ。此外，我们验证了U4CpG在患者来源血细胞中的激活和促进作用，并且低剂量的免疫刺激剂显著抑制了HIV-1的传播。进一步地，U4CpG处理的PBMC培养上清液在U1细胞中引发了潜伏HIV-1的转录，表明U4CpG逆转了HIV-1的潜伏状态。因此，U4CpG通过增强免疫和逆转潜伏来根除HIV-1的功能，使其成为临床研究中应对病毒感染的潜在候选材料。
